_note: PROVENANCE OF EVERY CLIP IN THE BARBARIAN'S BODY GLB, and the standing source-fidelity lint's input (21_lint_export.py rule SOURCE FIDELITY, via 56_clip_fidelity.py). Paths are relative to nb_d2/. A clip with a GLB `source` must match it within 0.10 of the rest hips-to-head at every frame (joints in the hips' physical frame), after its named `edits`; its source must be on the BODY's rig (rest pose within 0.01), or the lint fails it as fetched for another skeleton. `authored` clips have no library source; `legacy` clips are unused at runtime and slated for removal; FBX sources (SMPL-H) are not read here -- 41_retarget_smplh.py verifies its own rest alignment at export. Written 2026-09-30 (T12, N-C9-ASSEMBLE-DISTORTION).
